scope: Independent source, memory/lifecycle and authenticated opt-in review; bounded CPU tests only. No GPU or WSL execution.

pinned_math_source.checked: Original global neighbor map, sentinel mask, im2col gather, weight view/transpose and addmm/mm equations.

checked: Only six ordered modules are patched: blocks.2.8.conv2, blocks.3.0-3.3.conv, blocks.3.4.conv1. Exact module/input/weight/bias/source/static descriptor identities are required; foreign and repeated calls fail closed.

NativeBoundary captures the genuine full 438684-row map and its original coordinates at convolution34. All later five sites require the same neighbor cache object, map object and coordinate object. No tile-specific neighbor maps or index rebasing are introduced.

Only output rows and temporary im2col/gather/indices/mask/GEMM result are tiled. Every tile reads the entire global source, including cross-tile neighbors. BF16, checkpoint, strict precision conversion and weight layout remain unchanged.

Before native allocation, plan includes full map and ratio2 hash. After map creation only those already-live allowances are removed; after full output allocation only the already-live output allowance is additionally removed. Retained model, prior maps, coordinates and full output stay in measured live memory; original downstream block_extra is retained.

The optional manifest boolean defaultsFalse and is omitted from old canonical documents; enabling it changes the authenticated contract hash. Host CLI alone supplies the explicit opt-in, with existing exact-HEAD/committed-source/pre-marker gates and owned supervisor unchanged.

Shared original descriptor is restored and checked after both patches are removed, including failure cleanup. Handles, authentic cache references and hook-held tensors are cleared before existing collection/release checks.

Acceptance retains one parent forward, 40 original convolutions, eight original C2S operations, five native global maps, unchanged final64 tile coverage, strict output chain/readback and zero-release requirements; opt-in additionally requires complete ordered six-site receipts.

12GiB allocator cap, 13GiB initial free, 2GiB free reserve plus1GiB opaque headroom, 1.25 padding, all native/CPU/GPU/host deadlines, TunableOp-off policy, single owned Job and final64 tiler remain unchanged.

measured_support_plan.conclusion: No deterministic admission blocker follows from these bounded plans. Actual live allocator/device-free measurements must pass at every original site, full-output boundary and tile.

remaining_bounds.fourth_subdivision: Unknown until genuine logits; preserve strict >0 mask and exact C2S coordinate chain. No support truncation or cap relaxation.
remaining_bounds.statement: These are conservative CPU calculations, not predictions of the fourth mask, numerical output, runtime, peak memory or final generation success.

repaired_finding: Restoration diagnostic ordering now attests the shared descriptor after both the large and final patches are removed.
limitations: CPU arithmetic/lifecycle equivalence does not establish GPU BF16 bitwise equivalence across changed GEMM row sizes.
Fourth-stage support, live admissions, GPU performance and output validity remain unexecuted.
Root owns publication and authorization of any single genuine attempt; this review is not a runtime PASS.
